title: Perception becomes conscious when feeling is extended onto it

statements.text: Exteroceptive representations are unconscious in themselves and become conscious only when a more basic, affective consciousness selectively activates them. The relation of perception to consciousness is "I feel like this about that", where this is consciousness and that is perception. Cortex stabilizes feeling and so turns it into conscious cognition.

sources.quote: Exteroceptive representations are intrinsically unconscious things
I feel like this about that
cortex stabilizes consciousness rather than generates it
